issues.description: Cell 1 combines the champion reverse-scan PCE (21.44%) with VOC and JSC values explicitly described as averages. These values do not form one internally consistent device record.
issues.suggested_value: Either capture a single row from the supporting table or label averaged versus champion quantities explicitly.
issues.source_text: The averaged VOC and JSC for ES-based devices were 1.160 V and 21.59 mA cm−2; the champion reverse scan PCE was 21.44%.

issues.description: Cell 3 similarly mixes the champion n–i–p PCE (20.90%) with other metrics that yield about 19.79% when combined.
issues.suggested_value: Verify all four JV metrics against the same scan/device in Table S12 or S31.
issues.source_text: The champion ES-based n–i–p device was 20.90% reverse scan and 20.41% forward scan.
